none: PAS NLM-937565: Copy Denarius of Septimius Severus
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy with silver wash. Coin. Copy Denarius, probably of Septimius Severus (193-211), Reece period 11. Obverse description: Bust right. Obverse inscription: [--]PERT[--]. Reverse description: Female figure seated left holding globe, possibly Concordia.. Diameter: 17.2mm, Weight: 1.88gms, die axis: 6
